mapper.sql: select id, agent_code, agent_name, system_prompt, model_id, temperature, context_policy_id, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_agent
mapper.select:
AND agent_code like concat('%', #{agentCode}, '%') AND enabled = #{enabled} AND agent_name like concat('%', #{agentName}, '%')
order by id desc
mapper.delete: delete from ai_agent where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select tool_id from ai_agent_tool where agent_id = #{agentId} order by sort, tool_id
select t.tool_code from ai_agent_tool agt join ai_tool t on t.id = agt.tool_id where agt.agent_id = #{agentId} and t.enabled = '1' order by agt.sort, agt.tool_id
mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_tool (agent_id, tool_id, sort) values (#{agentId}, #{toolId}, #{sort})
mapper.select: select kb_id from ai_agent_knowledge where agent_id = #{agentId} order by sort, kb_id
select kb.kb_code from ai_agent_knowledge agk join ai_knowledge_base kb on kb.id = agk.kb_id where agk.agent_id = #{agentId} and kb.status = '0' order by agk.sort, agk.kb_id
mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_knowledge (agent_id, kb_id, sort) values (#{agentId}, #{kbId}, #{sort})
mapper.select: select skill_id from ai_agent_skill where agent_id = #{agentId} order by sort, skill_id
select s.skill_code from ai_agent_skill ags join ai_skill s on s.id = ags.skill_id where ags.agent_id = #{agentId} and s.enabled = '1' order by ags.sort, ags.skill_id
mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_skill (agent_id, skill_id, sort) values (#{agentId}, #{skillId}, #{sort})
